transactions.property_name: Suntec City Office Towers (six strata units divested in FY2024; a seventh completed 6 Jan 2025)
transactions.counterparty: Felix Petroleum Pte. Ltd.; Internet Sharing Pte. Ltd.; Tayen Investment Pte. Ltd.; Nuodasi International Trading Pte. Ltd.; and other unrelated third parties (six FY2024-completed strata units); one additional unrelated third party for the strata unit completed 6 January 2025
transactions.citation: full.md line 842 (Manager's Report): 'In navigating the current environment of elevated interest rates, $58.3 million of strata units at Suntec City Office Towers were divested at an average price of 24.5% above book value.' (Also line 286.) full.md line 848, footnote 1: 'The transactions in respect of the sale of strata units amounting to $58.3 million to separate unrelated third party investors namely Felix Petroleum Pte. Ltd., Internet Sharing Pte. Ltd., Tayen Investment Pte. Ltd. and Nuodasi International Trading Pte. Ltd. were entered into in FY2024. The sale of strata units amounting to $41.9 million, were completed in FY 2024 while the balance strata unit sale was completed on 6 January 2025.' full.md line 849, footnote 2: 'Based on the valuation of $47.1 million derived by multiplying the Rate of Lettable Floor Area ($ per square metre) per the 31 December 2023 (in respect of the $41.9 million divested in FY2024) and 31 December 2024 (in respect of the balance strata unit sale completed on 6 January 2025) independent valuation reports by the net lettable area of the divested strata units, using the income capitalisation, discounted cashflow and direct comparison methods.' full.md line 4961 (Note 6, Investment Properties movement): 'Divestments | (34,402) | (32,734) | (34,402) | (32,734)'. full.md line 4970: 'During the year, Suntec REIT had completed the divestment of six (2023: four) strata units in Suntec City Office to unrelated third parties. These divested strata units contributed to a net gain of $14,992,000 in the financial year ended 31 December 2024.'
transactions.notes: RECONCILIATION WORKED OUT PER ASSIGNMENT: the headline text (line 842) calls the 24.5% premium 'above book value', but that wording does not reconcile against the audited carrying-value figure. Note 6's 'Divestments' movement line ($34,402,000, line 4961) is the aggregate CARRYING AMOUNT DERECOGNISED for the six strata units that were both sold AND completed within FY2024 (the narrower subset described at line 4970) -- it does NOT correspond to the $58.3m headline sale figure, which per footnote 1 (line 848) covers ALL strata-unit sale AGREEMENTS ENTERED INTO in FY2024 (seven units: six completing in FY2024 = $41.9m, plus one more completing 6 Jan 2025 = the balance, together totalling $58.3m). $58.3m / $34.402m - 1 = +69.4%, nowhere near the disclosed 24.5%, confirming $34.402m is the WRONG denominator for this headline figure (it is a real, audited number, but for a different, narrower population of units). The AR itself supplies the correct denominator in footnote 2 (line 849): an aggregate INDEPENDENT VALUATION of $47.1m, explicitly computed (via per-sqm rate x NLA, using the appropriate valuation date for each tranche) to correspond to the SAME set of units and the SAME $58.3m sale figure the 24.5% premium is calculated on. $58.3m / $47.1m - 1 = +23.78%, closely matching (though not exactly equal to) the disclosed 24.5% -- the small residual gap is attributable to the disclosed figure being an 'average' of per-unit premia (each unit's own price vs its own per-sqm valuation) rather than a premium computed on the aggregated totals used here. Conclusion: despite the AR's own prose calling this 'book value', the reference the 24.5% is actually measured against is an independent VALUATION, so reference_basis is recorded as 'valuation' (not 'book_value') and reference_value = $47,100,000 SGD, per SPEC rule 5 (never balance by assumption -- the $34.402m book-value figure is recorded here as context, not forced into the reference_value field it does not fit). gross_sale_price=$58,300,000 SGD (full FY2024-entered program, matching the $47.1m valuation basis); of this, $41.9m SGD completed within FY2024 and the balance (~$16.4m) completed 6 Jan 2025. Separately, the six units completed-and-derecognised within FY2024 (Note 6 subset) had book value $34,402,000 and net gain $14,992,000 (~43.6% above that narrower book-value base) -- this audited subset figure is NOT the basis for the disclosed 24.5% and is not used as reference_value.
